hook_line: MALAYSIA ENDS VISA-FREE ENTRY FOR INDIANS FROM JANUARY 1, 2027

hook_stat.sub: Malaysia ends the 30-day visa exemption for Indian passport holders

stats.label: Visa applications open on the MyVISA portal
Visa-free stays remain available until December 31, 2026
Indian tourist arrivals in Malaysia in 2025

diaspora_bullets: Your arrival date decides whether you need a visa — not your booking or departure date
The Malaysia Digital Arrival Card is still required within three days before arrival
news_summary: Malaysia will end visa-free entry for Indian passport holders from January 1, 2027; travellers arriving on or after that date must obtain a visa in advance through the MyVISA portal, with applications opening December 1, 2026.
payoff: Until December 31, 2026, Indians can still enter visa-free for up to 30 days — from January 1, 2027, a visa obtained before travel is required.
